song: 65 - Michael Jackson - In the Closet (Official Video - Upscaled)
title: the metal object lifts through the build and flashes at the drop
story: In the Closet at 112 BPM. The pre-roll is a thin, quiet build (rms 0.068, onset 1.78) that steps up at the anomaly and lands on the drop at 5952 (rms 0.068 -> 0.159, +2.13 sd). The superformula object is given a metal skin (kind 4) that is barely there in the build and comes up across it, so the object reads as the part gets heavier: mix 0.12 -> 0.35 as the build climbs, then 0.9 on the drop with a hard light. The strongest onset of the whole span (18.41@5958) gets one broken-surface glitch on the hit, gone six ticks later. Post-roll settles to a steady metal 0.6 that could loop.
